$comment: bankai-fleet registry (zheref/hatsu#620): the one roster of every in-scope maintained zheref repository, with its stack and its owner, and nothing else. Pin values are NOT stored here: each consumer's own nen/ configuration holds its pins, and the tooling reads them live and reports drift. Inventory: Fuegoleon's section of the Engineering Hub, 2026-11-21 -- every maintained zheref repository minus the weekly-check exclusions Sergio ruled that day. `stack` is the scenario the repository declares in its own nen/repos.json where it declares one; else `bankai-machinery` for a Bankai process repository (bankai-scaffold), else the framework its tree shows. The stack vocabulary is fixed by the roster's validation (zheref/hatsu#620, child 2). `owner` is the guild member who owns the repository's work: Fuegoleon for the Bankai process and library repositories, Laxus for the products. The private repositories here are named by the maintainer's rulings HR-143 (akatsuki-ai) and HR-396 (the rest) (docs/ROSTER.md sections Rulings of 2026-10-19 and Rulings of 2026-11-22; docs/PUBLIC-REDACTION.md section Named private repositories). G4 canon: a change to this file needs Sergio's G4 (2026-11-21 ruling on zheref/hatsu#620, OQ-1).
